source.snippet: Ask HN: 'For an app claiming end-to-end encryption, what evidence would earn your trust?' — 3 points, 3 comments, recent (2026-08-05). Question implies users and buyers of secure-messaging or data tools cannot evaluate E2E encryption claims independently.

problem_statement: Businesses and security-conscious users buying or evaluating apps that claim end-to-end encryption have no standardized, accessible way to verify those claims, leading to distrust and stalled purchasing decisions.
target_segment: IT/security buyers at SMBs and enterprises evaluating secure communication or data storage SaaS tools
notes: Business buyer angle: procurement teams blocked on vendor trust. A certification or third-party audit badge service (like SOC2 but focused on E2E claims) could command subscription fees from vendors seeking buyer trust.
